verdict.rationale: Workflow automation is a fair axis for a team chat product, but the evidence pack contains no no-code workflow builder triggered by events, schedules, or form submissions. The only related material is developer building blocks (Graph APIs, the Agents Toolkit CLI, bots) and adjacent webhooks/connectors, none of which is a no-code admin workflow capability.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can build no-code workflows triggered by events, schedules, or form submissions inside the chat tool
